title: Employ staff under the Fast Food Industry Award 2020
what: Pay and employ staff at no less than the terms of the Fast Food Industry Award 2020.

sources.title: Fast Food Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.1 This industry award covers, to the exclusion of any other modern award: (a) employers in the fast food industry throughout Australia; and (b) employees (within a classification defined in clause 12.4 ) of employers mentioned in clause 4.1(a) .

sources.title: Fast Food Industry Award 2020
sources.quote: 4.2 In this award fast food industry means the industry of taking orders for, preparing and selling (by direct provision to the customer and/or by delivery to the customer’s address): (a) meals, snacks and/or beverages, which are sold to the public primarily to be consumed away from the point of sale; (b) take away foods and beverages packaged, sold or served in such a manner as to allow their being taken from the point of sale to be consumed elsewhere should the customer so decide ; and/or (c) food and/or beverages in food courts and/or in shopping centres and/or in retail complexes, excluding coffee shops, cafes, bars and restaurants providing primarily a sit-down service inside the catering establishment.

sources.title: Which system of employment laws applies
sources.publisher: Government of Western Australia (Private Sector Labour Relations)
sources.quote: The state system covers: Private sector businesses and their employees that operate as: Sole traders. Partnerships, where none of the partners in the business is a constitutional corporation (trading or financial corporation).

assessment.summary: The Fast Food Industry Award sets the industry's classifications, minimum pay, allowances and penalty rates on top of the National Employment Standards.

marks.reason: Classifications, allowances, penalty rates and their record-keeping add to the cost and complexity of employing in the industry.
